messages.subject: Installation issues
parts:
Hi, I am having trouble installing INLA. The installations seems successful: 
> library(INLA)
Loading required package: Matrix
Loading required package: sp
This is INLA_24.01.14 built 2024-01-14 09:55:58 UTC.
 - See www.r-inla.org/contact-us for how to get help.
 - List available models/likelihoods/etc with inla.list.models()
 - Use inla.doc(<NAME>) to access documentation
 - Save 186.4Mb of storage running 'inla.prune()'

Then when I then run the example on https://www.r-inla.org/download-install I get the following error: 
> result = inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = data)
Error in inla.call.builtin() : INLA installation error; no such file 

I have tried installing both stable and testing versions according to the instructions on https://www.r-inla.org/download-install, and also downloading the .tgz and compiling from the locally saved file. Same results: everything suggests the installation is successful, but when I run the inla() function, R tells me there’s an installation error. I am running R version 4.3.2 on MacOS Monterey. Do you have any suggestions? 

All the best, 
Cas
